item.title: Bitcoin price drops to $62.5K as trader warns weekly close may spark more losses
item.summary: Bitcoin falls further toward new August lows, ignoring positive US inflation trends while US stocks continue to circle all-time highs. Bitcoin (BTC) declined into Friday’s Wall Street open as traders increasingly saw a BTC price breakdown next. Key points: Data from TradingView showed BTC/USD down 1.3% on the day at $62,570, near its lowest levels month-to-date. Read more
